name: FSFFL Roster Decision Lab
purpose: Ephemeral what-if engine for trades, adds, drops, cuts, and multi-step roster decisions without mutating the canonical Sleeper league state.
principles: Canonical Sleeper data is read-only input.
Every scenario is applied only in memory.
Baseline and hypothetical simulations use identical random seeds and projection inputs.
Weekly legal lineups are re-optimized after every scenario.
Current-season impact and long-term strategic value are reported separately.
Opponent-strengthening effects are measured for bilateral trades.
Future picks remain attached to their original franchise for pick-quality modeling even when ownership changes.
core_dependencies: current Sleeper roster and pick state
state_policy: Scenario files and outputs may be committed for audit, but hypothetical player/pick ownership must never be written into canonical data/rosters.json, traded_picks.json, or GM daily outputs.
